seen.body: Found by the drafts lane: draft revert refuses approved work whose pr mirror is not recorded as draft (draft key is not true). qew pr open now records draft; qew pr ready flips the forge flag but leaves the mirror saying draft true, and pr ready is not a ledger-writing verb in replication.verb_for, so a mirror rewrite would be uncommitted. Record draft false on ready inside a session verb.
seen.title: qew pr ready must record draft:false in the pr mirror (and run in a ledger session)
